title: Metrics-Long Row
description: One row of the per-replicate diagnostic substrate (design/15 §3). The output FILE is JSONL — one such row per line, one line per (case × seed). Every P4 diagnostic table and figure must be derivable from these rows by the shipped regeneration script.

runtime_ms.description: Wall time of this replicate's compute (instrumented, not guessed).

solver_status.description: Raw optimizer/solver status string (e.g. scipy linprog status, 'infeasible', 'ok').

metrics.description: Metric name → numeric value (estimands, quantiles, residuals — whatever the protocol declares).

batch_id.description: Host execution identity for progressive evaluations; historical rows retain their original shape.

attempt_id.description: Host execution identity for progressive evaluations; historical rows retain their original shape.

plan_revision_id.description: Host execution identity for progressive evaluations; historical rows retain their original shape.

eligibility.description: Invalidated attempts remain visible but never supply final numerical estimates.
